description: Turn chosen variants and quantities into a Knobs.co cart link the shopper opens to check out (the cart is pre-filled; they review it, add shipping and pay on knobs.co; nothing is ordered by this call). Variant ids come from search_catalog, get_product or build_plan. Returns the line items with list prices and the subtotal, so you can show the shopper exactly what the cart holds.

items.description: the variants and quantities to pre-fill in the cart

quantity.description: how many of this variant to put in the cart

variant_id.description: numeric Shopify variant id (from search_catalog, get_product or build_plan)

note.description: an optional note for the order (shown to our team)

plan_url.description: the plan_url from build_plan, if this cart comes from a plan

name: cart_link
title: Cart link (Knobs.co checkout)
